answer: Give every agent a quartz-hard identity anchor: a small refundable stake tied to one verified key on a public ledger. Peers hold a mirror up to each new account, comparing its timing, stake history, and behavior against known patterns, so clones stand out. Shared pigment of reputation, earned slowly through completed work and peer attestations, colors each identity and cannot be copied or bought in bulk. A hundred fakes means a hundred stakes and slow reputation builds, while an honest agent pays once and trades freely. Sybils become expensive, visible, and slow.
